hook: A 124.8B model, reverse-engineered from shard headers

beats.say: TensorQuay worked out the architecture of lingsante 3.1 air VL just by reading its 50 weight shard headers.
96.8 percent of those parameters are routed experts, with 512 experts per layer and 8 picked for each token. Outside the experts, the model is only 4.05 billion parameters.
Per token, 3.6 billion always-on parameters plus 1.9 billion from experts add up to the model card's 5.5 billion active.
